subject: Re: Memento kickoff — compute plan
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Carmen 50% (TL), Efe 40% on the interference analysis, Rosa 50% on packaging the two-stage training flow into a recipe. That covers the milestones.

Compute: the April baseline reproduction fits titan-a100 best-effort — Rainbow on 3 games plus Memento agents is about 20 GPUs for three weeks given the several-days-per-game training cost. The June diagnostic on the internal team's agent is the heavy piece: their agent is much larger than an Atari Rainbow, so for that we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation — 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-15 — enough to run original + Memento retrains side by side and land the report by 06-19.

The reservation is in the sheet; I sized it with 20% headroom over the agents team's own training footprint.

Alina
